scope: defensive review of repository-owned code; Cash App integration only

findings.observation: Access-Control-Allow-Origin wildcard is applied to JSON API responses
findings.recommendation: For future authenticated Cash App endpoints use explicit trusted origins, deny credentialed cross-origin requests by default.

findings.observation: Error handler returns error.message to clients
findings.recommendation: Use generic public errors and log details privately, especially for future financial endpoints.

findings.observation: Banking bridge URL comes from environment and is used in fetch
findings.recommendation: Validate configured HTTPS origin and block unexpected destinations before connecting any new financial module.

findings.observation: Configuration states secrets must remain in environment variables and HTTPS is required
findings.recommendation: Enforce these requirements in runtime tests.

cashAppPlannedControls: No payment submission without explicit authorization
